**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate backend-specific paths before creating the attempt**

When a Qwen invocation omits `--model-path` or `--integrity-dir`, or a DeepSeek invocation omits `--key-file`, these optional values are passed to the worker only after the immutable output directory and its protocol/messages files have been created. The worker then fails during initialization, but a formal `holdout-<backend>-1` directory now exists and the runner refuses to reuse it, so a simple CLI omission can consume the experiment's sole formal attempt without making a model request. Reject missing backend-specific options before `mkdir(out)`.
